AJ: Thanks for making time, Linda. Tell me about a normal week at Ridgeline.
Linda Marsh: Sure. We're an independent property and casualty agency, four of us, about 900 policies. The biggest drain is renewals. Every policy that renews in the next 30 days needs a renewal email and a remarket quote, and right now I go through the carrier download by hand every Monday. That's about 5 hours a week.
AJ: Got it. What else?
Linda Marsh: Certificates of insurance. Our contractor clients need COIs for every new job site. We get maybe 15 requests a week and each one takes about 20 minutes, so call it 5 hours a week for Jamal.
Linda Marsh: Then claims status. Clients call asking where their claim is, and we chase the adjuster. That's about 3 hours a week.
Linda Marsh: And once a month I reconcile carrier commission statements against our book. That's a full afternoon, 6 hours, once a month.
AJ: If you woke up tomorrow and one thing was already done, what would it be?
Linda Marsh: If I woke up tomorrow and there was a list of every policy renewing in the next 30 days that hasn't been quoted yet, soonest first, with a renewal email drafted to each client, I'd be thrilled.
AJ: Any rules the agent must follow?
Linda Marsh: Two hard rules. Never quote a premium or tell a client their coverage is bound. Only a licensed agent, me or Jamal, can do that.
Linda Marsh: And never contact Castillo Builders about anything. Marco Castillo is in a billing dispute with us and that account goes through me personally. Also, for Dr. Okoro's dental practice, only ever talk to Dr. Okoro himself, never the front desk.
AJ: Perfect. What tools do you use?
Linda Marsh: Applied Epic for the agency management system, Outlook for email, and RingCentral for phones.
